name: Julienne Blackburn Coaching
description: Trauma-informed life coaching for survivors of narcissistic and emotional abuse. One-on-one coaching, small group sessions, free printable prayers, and grounding practices.
footerNote: Coaching is not therapy, counseling, or medical care. If you are in immediate danger, call 911. For confidential support, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is available 24/7 at 1-800-799-7233.
